title: March to the Death
author: Pr1nted
$comment: Full military band -- trumpets, piccolo, horns, tuba, timpani and field drums. Asks for a DECISIVE war against an equal, where winning still costs something, and stays out of the undecided middle where Parade Uniform and Bombing Voronezh belong. This used to carry "valenceMode": "magnitude" so that one piece could cover a war being won AND a war being lost catastrophically -- there was nothing else for the second. Last Stand is now that piece, and a track covering both directions would simply shadow it everywhere, so the dual duty is retired and each keeps one meaning. Blitzkrieg holds the same decisiveness against someone far smaller, where it does not. Restricted to game -- a death march has no business on a title screen.
